item.text: I had kept the coat for years, long after it became too small, as though I might somehow fit into it again. Before donating it, I checked the pockets and found an old cinema ticket. I couldn’t remember the film, but I remembered the friend beside me, laughing as we came out into the cold. I put the ticket in a drawer and folded the coat for someone else. It was easier to let it go than I had expected.
